workflow: An element-assignment operation invokes user-defined conversion logic before performing the write.
The conversion logic re-enters the same container and clears or shrinks its backing storage.
The outer assignment continues using the pre-conversion storage state without revalidating its pointer and bounds.
The write dereferences released or null storage, causing a memory-safety crash instead of a recoverable bounds error.
summary: Reentrant mutation invalidates container storage during assignment
